name: EPIC 206335422

text.card: A red giant 3,123 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.87 solar masses and 11.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,534 K at its surface.
